content_zh:

content_en:
Cyberjaya renovation projects should consider property type, management rules, working hours, material delivery, itemized budget, and after-sales responsibility. Common project types include Condo, Terrace house, Semi-D, Office, Retail shop, Warehouse, with frequent requests such as Full renovation, Kitchen cabinet, Bathroom waterproofing, Built-in furniture, Office fit-out, Shop renovation.

FLASH CAST first reviews the location, area, project type, budget, photos, and site condition before preparing a practical scope. Owners can send details by WhatsApp or the free quote form so we can advise whether a site measurement is needed.

Cyberjaya projects should confirm management application, working hours, material delivery, protection works, parking, and noise limits early.
